_comment: Top Five Guess: one light retirement question and the five answers most people would give, ranked most to least likely. The question and answer budgets arrive on the request (frontend/src/utils/studio/top-five-guess/content.ts); the limits below are the hard bounds any request is clamped into. Points are never asked of the model: the page scores rank 1-5 as 5-4-3-2-1, so the ranking and the scores cannot disagree. blockedTerms keep sensitive topics and anything that reads as real polling data off the page. qualifierWords are dropped before two answers are compared, so MEETINGS and TOO MANY MEETINGS count as one answer.

locale.nativeLine: - Write in clear, warm English for adults and retirees.
